**Naive Managed Agents is a managed agent platform**: you define an [agent](https://usenaive.ai/docs/capabilities/agent) — model, prompt, tools, skills, budget — and run it as [sessions](https://usenaive.ai/docs/concepts/sessions) that work for hours, pause at storage cost, and finish without a person in the loop. You pay per finished task, in real dollars, priced before each call runs.

**Two layers, one stack.** Naive Managed Agents is the autonomous-company infrastructure — the harness, the managed runtime, sessions, budgets, tools. Naive **blueprints** are the layer on top: the templates a whole company is installed from, and the [studio](https://app.usenaive.ai/) you run it in. These pages are the Managed Agents reference.

**Why you’ll see `vetta`.** A few API identifiers still carry the old name, including the `api.vetta.sh` host and the `Vetta-Version` header. They’re the same product as Naive.

Everything is built around one number: **the most intelligence per dollar spent** — the same model on different stacks varies several-fold in cost per completed task ( [benchmarks](https://usenaive.ai/blogs/introducing-naive-managed-agents)).![Naive Managed Agents — managed agents infrastructure: any model and provider, skills, and tools in; harness, runtime, orchestration, and self-improvement inside; run and interact through the Web Studio, API, CLI, and SDK](https://mintcdn.com/vetta/U1iUpSFRnmMwfSsJ/images/architecture-overview.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=U1iUpSFRnmMwfSsJ&q=85&s=fe760fd7f5f313494ae586505b409791)Any model, your skills, and your tools go in; Managed Agents’ runtime does the work; and you run and interact through the [Web Studio](https://app.usenaive.ai/), the [API](https://usenaive.ai/docs/api/overview), the [CLI](https://usenaive.ai/docs/cli/overview), or the [SDK](https://usenaive.ai/docs/sdk/typescript).

## [​](https://usenaive.ai/docs/index\#create-an-agent-run-a-session)  Create an agent, run a session

TypeScript

CLI

```
// ESM only: set "type": "module" in package.json, or name the file .mts
import { createClient } from "@usenaive-sdk/managed-agents";

const naive = createClient({ baseUrl: "https://api.vetta.sh", apiKey: process.env.NAIVE_API_KEY! });

const agent = await naive.agents.create({
  name: `triage-${Date.now()}`,
  model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash",
  system: "You are a concise triage agent.",
  budget: { cap_micro_usd: 50_000_000, max_task_micro_usd: 5_000_000, period: "month" },
});

const session = await naive.sessions.create({
  agent_id: agent.id,
  message: "Summarize what changed in main overnight.",
});

for await (const event of naive.stream(session.id)) {
  console.log(event.type);
}
```

```
npm i -g @usenaive-sdk/cli
read -rs KEY && printf '%s\n' "$KEY" | naive login   # piped: the key stays out of argv and shell history

AGENT=$(naive agent create --name triage --model z-ai/glm-5.3-flash \
  --budget-usd 50 --max-task-usd 5 --budget-period month \
  --system "You are a concise triage agent." | jq -r .id)

SID=$(naive session create --agent "$AGENT" \
  --message "Summarize what changed in main overnight." | jq -r .id)

naive session stream --session "$SID"
```

## [​](https://usenaive.ai/docs/index\#the-pillars-as-objects)  The pillars, as objects

Everything you touch maps to primitives you create and version — familiar on day one.

[**Agent** \\
\\
A reusable, versioned config: model, harness, prompt, tools, skills, budget.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/capabilities/agent)

[**Session** \\
\\
One directly-controlled run of an agent — send input, stream output, interrupt, resume.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/concepts/sessions)

[**Events** \\
\\
A resumable stream of everything the agent does, keyed by sequence number.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/concepts/events-and-streaming)

[**Computer** \\
\\
A disposable sandbox with a filesystem, shell, and optional browser — paused when idle.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/capabilities/computer)

[**Skills** \\
\\
Persisted, versioned expertise loaded with progressive disclosure.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/capabilities/skills)

[**Files** \\
\\
Durable, organization-scoped storage for the artifacts a session produces.](https://usenaive.ai/docs/capabilities/files)

## [​](https://usenaive.ai/docs/index\#how-naive-managed-agents-earns-the-highest-roi-per-dollar)  How Naive Managed Agents earns the highest ROI per dollar

Four independent levers, all cutting dollars per finished task without cutting quality.

Managed sandbox

Pay only for running time

Every agent gets a disposable micro-VM that pauses between turns — you pay for stored disk, not a machine sitting hot. A fully virtualized V8-isolate mode for near-instant boot is coming soon.

Durable loop

Waiting = storage, not compute

The loop is an alarm, not a call stack: wake, take one turn, commit, sleep. A run that spans hours pays for storage between turns, not a machine sitting hot.

Completion window

One model, three prices

Trade latency for cost per request — immediate, priority, or loose. Same weights, different tariff. Non-urgent work runs on the cheapest lane.

Model + delegation

Right model per step

Pick the model per agent, and delegate sub-tasks to smaller specialists so the long transcript never rides along on every downstream call.
